data.title: Wire report announces transit restrictions in the strait
data.author: human
data.body:
A (fictional) wire agency reports that the coastal state will restrict night
transits of laden tankers through the strait from 1 October.

This card is the origin of the provenance chain in this example: the two
media cards below only repeat it.
